adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the diff explicitly sets `response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL"`. `ALLOWALL` is not a standard/valid `X-Frame-Options` value (valid values are typically `DENY` / `SAMEORIGIN` / legacy `ALLOW-FROM`), so browsers may ignore it. The controller then relies on the `request.referer` host check for restricting embedding, which is the only concrete protection shown in the diff.
